items.title: Toybox.Application.AppBase.onNightModeChanged()
items.description_markdown: The AppBase callback for a device switch between day and night mode on supported devices. Re-read `System.getDeviceSettings().isNightModeEnabled`, update the active palette and request a redraw without altering the configured fields or numeric values.

items.title: Toybox.System.getDeviceSettings().isNightModeEnabled
items.description_markdown: Read the current device night-color state through `System.getDeviceSettings().isNightModeEnabled` when this member is present. It is available on newer supported Edge devices but not every target in [APP-24](#app-24); use a capability check and the explicit theme fallback instead of assuming this property exists.

items.title: Toybox.WatchUi.DataField.createField(...)
items.description_markdown: A DataField may call `Toybox.WatchUi.DataField.createField(...)` to create a `FitContributor.Field` for optional custom FIT recording. The returned field is updated with `setData(...)` when the data is valid. This is not required to display values on screen. Garmin API: https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/api-docs/Toybox/WatchUi/DataField.html

items.title: Toybox.UserProfile.getProfile()
items.description_markdown: Retrieves the user's general profile data, such as body metrics, when the UserProfile permission is granted. Training-zone thresholds are retrieved separately through `Toybox.UserProfile.getHeartRateZones(...)` and, on supported devices, `getPowerZones(...)`; `getProfile()` alone is not a source of zone boundaries.

items.title: Toybox.System.getSystemStats()
items.description_markdown: Toybox.System.getSystemStats() returns System.Stats, including battery percentage and application-runtime totalMemory, usedMemory and freeMemory in bytes. Validate battery under [DVS-35](#dvs-35); use the named memory members for the separate qualification measurements under [APP-48](#app-48). These are not device physical RAM or filesystem-free-storage values, and no free-storage member is documented by this contract. Label foreground/background/simulator/hardware measurement provenance separately; published limits alone are not measured free memory. Source: https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/api-docs/Toybox/System/Stats.html

items.title: onHide()
items.description_markdown: Toybox.WatchUi.View.onHide() is the inherited View hide callback when delivered by the system. It may suspend display-only work, but shall not stop required activity sample processing, clear rolling samples solely because the field is hidden or reset timer/settings state. Do not depend on an onHide callback for every Data Field visibility transition; the documented Data Field lifecycle primarily lists onLayout/onShow/onUpdate. Restore current rendering under [APP-13](#app-13) without inventing samples. Source: https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/api-docs/Toybox/WatchUi/View.html

items.title: onShow()
items.description_markdown: Toybox.WatchUi.View.onShow(), inherited by DataField, is a visibility callback. When the view becomes visible, render/request the current complete snapshot using the current validated settings and rebuilt layout as needed. Becoming visible shall not reset activity timers, rolling samples, hidden assignments or saved settings. Do not assume visibility callbacks supply Activity.Info or replace [APP-8](#app-8) acquisition. Source: https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/api-docs/Toybox/WatchUi/View.html#onShow-instance_function

items.title: onStart(state)
items.description_markdown: Toybox.Application.AppBase.onStart(state) is called at application startup before getInitialView(). Handle application startup and load/validate saved configuration without assuming state is non-null, an activity sample is already available or a final drawing area has been assigned. Layout preparation follows [APP-7](#app-7) and safe snapshot initialization follows [APP-33](#app-33). App startup is not an instruction to reset the host Garmin activity. Source: https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/api-docs/Toybox/Application/AppBase.html#onStart-instance_function

items.title: getInitialView()
items.description_markdown: Toybox.Application.AppBase.getInitialView() returns the initial view array, containing this application's WatchUi.DataField instance. That view receives layout/update and activity-compute callbacks. An input delegate is optional when supported/needed; do not require an on-device settings editor under [APP-46](#app-46). Initialize a complete safe display state under [APP-33](#app-33) before returning the view. Source: https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/api-docs/Toybox/Application/AppBase.html#getInitialView-instance_function
